title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Update Payment Information
content:
Users can update their payment method at any time:

- Navigate to 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'
- Tap 'Add New Card' or select an existing card to edit
- Enter card details and billing address
- Tap 'Save' to confirm
- The new payment method will be used for the next billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment information by going to 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods' in the CultPass app. Your changes will take effect on your next billing date."

title: Refund Policy and Process
content:
CultPass refund policy:

- Subscription fees are non-refundable once charged
- Premium event fees may be refunded up to 48 hours before the event
- Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days
- To request a refund, contact support with your reservation ID
- Refunds require approval from support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Subscription fees are non-refundable, but premium event fees can be refunded if canceled at least 48 hours before the event. Please provide your reservation ID to process the refund."

title: How to Change Account Email
content:
To change the email associated with your account:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'
- Tap 'Email Address'
- Enter your new email and confirm
- Verify the new email via the confirmation link sent
- Your old email will receive a notification of the change

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your email in 'My Account' > 'Profile Settings'. You'll need to verify your new email address via a confirmation link."

title: Premium vs Basic Tier Differences
content:
CultPass offers two subscription tiers:

**Basic Tier:**
- 4 experiences per month
- Access to standard events
- Standard customer support

**Premium Tier:**
- 10 experiences per month
- Priority access to all events including exclusive ones
- Early booking for high-demand experiences
- Priority customer support
- Discounts on additional premium events

**Suggested phrasing:**
"The Premium tier includes 10 monthly experiences, priority access to exclusive events, and priority support. The Basic tier includes 4 monthly experiences with access to standard events."

title: How to View Reservation History
content:
To view your past and upcoming reservations:

- Open the CultPass app
- Tap on 'My Reservations' from the main menu
- Toggle between 'Upcoming' and 'Past' tabs
- Tap any reservation to view details, QR code, or cancellation options
- You can download receipts for past events

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can view all your reservations in the 'My Reservations' section of the app. Toggle between upcoming and past events to see your history."

title: App Not Loading or Crashing
content:
If the CultPass app is not loading or crashing:

- Force close the app and restart it
- Check your internet connection
- Clear the app cache: Settings > Apps > CultPass > Clear Cache
- Update to the latest version from the app store
- Restart your device
- If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the app
- Contact support if problems continue

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try force closing and restarting the app. If that doesn't work, clear the app cache or update to the latest version. You can also try reinstalling the app."

title: How to Cancel a Reservation
content:
To cancel an existing reservation:

- Go to 'My Reservations' in the app
- Select the reservation you want to cancel
- Tap 'Cancel Reservation'
- Confirm the cancellation
- Your monthly quota will be restored if canceled at least 24 hours before the event
- Late cancellations (less than 24 hours) will not restore your quota

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel a reservation in 'My Reservations' by selecting the event and tapping 'Cancel Reservation'. Cancel at least 24 hours in advance to restore your monthly quota."

title: Account Blocked or Suspended
content:
If your account has been blocked or suspended:

- This usually occurs due to policy violations or payment issues
- Check your email for a notification explaining the reason
- For payment-related blocks, update your payment method and contact support
- For policy violations, review our Terms of Service
- Contact support to appeal or resolve the issue
- Escalate to human agent for account reinstatement

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your account may be blocked due to payment issues or policy violations. Please check your email for details and contact support to resolve the issue."

title: How to Invite Friends and Referral Program
content:
CultPass referral program:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Invite Friends'
- Share your unique referral code via email, SMS, or social media
- When a friend signs up using your code, both of you receive 1 bonus experience
- Bonus experiences are added to your account within 48 hours
- No limit on the number of referrals
- Referral bonuses expire after 90 days if unused

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Share your unique referral code from 'My Account' > 'Invite Friends'. Both you and your friend will receive 1 bonus experience when they sign up!"

title: Accessibility Features and Support
content:
CultPass is committed to accessibility:

- The app supports screen readers and voice commands
- High contrast mode available in Settings > Accessibility
- Font size can be adjusted in Settings > Display
- Many partner venues offer wheelchair access and assistance
- Check event details for specific accessibility information
- Contact support for special accommodation requests

**Suggested phrasing:**
"CultPass supports screen readers, high contrast mode, and adjustable font sizes. Check individual event details for venue accessibility information, or contact us for special accommodations."

title: Monthly Quota and Rollover Policy
content:
Understanding your monthly experience quota:

- Your quota resets on the 1st of each month
- Unused experiences do NOT roll over to the next month
- Premium tier users get 10 experiences, Basic tier users get 4
- Bonus experiences from referrals are separate and expire after 90 days
- You can upgrade mid-month to increase your quota immediately
- Downgrading takes effect at the next billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your monthly quota resets on the 1st of each month and unused experiences don't roll over. Upgrade anytime to increase your quota immediately."

title: How to Provide Feedback or Report Issues
content:
We value your feedback:

- In-app: Tap 'Help' > 'Send Feedback'
- Rate your experience after each event
- Report technical issues via 'Help' > 'Report a Problem'
- Include screenshots if possible
- For urgent issues, use the chat support feature
- We respond to all feedback within 24-48 hours

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can send feedback or report issues through 'Help' > 'Send Feedback' in the app. For urgent matters, please use our chat support feature."
